'''Clik''' was the alias of a [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]], whose name at birth was unpronounceable by non-Verpines. He worked as a quartermaster for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel alliance]] on [[Arda I]]. Clik was skilled at weapon modification, and most of the [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] he revised were more accurate and deadly.

==Appearances==
*''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'' {{1st}}
